prompt:
배경은 한강 위 마포대교 다리 위, 시대는 21세기. 다리는 중간부터 붕괴되고, 차들은 이리저리 부딪힌 상황. 시민들은 좀비화 되어있는 상태.
1: 검정색 트렌치코트와 검정 셔츠와 검정 벨트, 검정 정장핏 바지와 구두를 신고 등에 칼을 찬, 머리를 반만 깐 검정 머리의 차갑게 생긴 인상의 사내가 걸어온다.
2. 사내가 앞을 보며, '너, 뭐냐?'라고 서늘한 표정을 지으며 묻는다.
3. 사내의 오른편에 하늘색 게임 창이 뜨며, <등장인물 요약 알림> 과 함께 그 밑에 써지는 글씨들,
' 인물: 유중혁
  특성: 회귀자 <3회차> (신화), 프로게이머(희귀)
  전용 스킬: [현자의 눈 Lv.8] [백병전 Lv.8].. '
4.그 순간 사내가 손을 뻗어 다른 회사원의 옷차림을 한 남자의 멱살을 잡는다.' 
5.회사원 옷차림의 남자의 얼굴을 왼쪽 위에서 비추며, 유중혁은 손을 놓고 회사원 남자는 바로 밑에 있던 용의 입 속으로 떨어진다.

6. 그 다음 배경은 용의 위 속이다. 붉은 색의 점막들로 뒤덮여있는 곳이다. 위 속에서 회사원 남자는 희고 동그란, 농구공 사이즈 크기의 머리의 노란 뿔이 두개 달리고 갈색 거적때기를 입은 눈 2개의 도깨비와 이야기를 한다.
7. 도깨비는 사라지고, 위 속에서 위액의 푸른 액체가 쌓인다. 회사원 남자는 위 벽에 가시들을 박은 채, 손으로 각 가시를 하나씩 잡고 발로 다른 가시들을 지탱해서 서 있는다.
8. 위액이 사라지고, 푸른색의 구슬을 회사원 남자가 줍는다.

environment.overview: Twenty-first-century Seoul’s Mapo Bridge and the dragon’s organic interior share a stark charcoal-to-pale-gray treatment, contrasting utilitarian concrete and steel with glossy dark-red membrane beneath overcast exterior light and dim interior reflections.
environment.location_type: A continuous route from an outdoor bridge above the Han River into an open dragon mouth and an enclosed stomach.

zones.name: Wrecked roadway
zones.description: Concrete traffic lanes, faded lane markings, steel side railings, bent lamp poles, and collided sedans with buckled bodywork; the Han River and a subdued modern skyline are visible beyond the railings

zones.name: Collapse edge
zones.description: A jagged mid-span break with exposed reinforcing bars, fractured lane markings, a crushed sedan against the surviving railing, and open river beyond the missing roadway; the dragon’s upturned jaws are directly below the lip

zones.name: Dragon mouth
zones.description: An enormous upward-facing jaw with conical teeth, a slick tongue, ridged palate, and a dark throat opening; a narrow strip of broken bridge is visible overhead and river water is visible outside the jaws

zones.name: Dragon stomach
zones.description: A tall enclosed chamber of dark-red mucosal folds, branching veins, glistening ridges, a concave fleshy floor, narrow drainage creases, and a dark throat aperture overhead

baseline.lighting: soft gray daylight outdoors; faint diffuse red illumination and wet reflected highlights inside the stomach.

breakdown.logline: On zombie-overrun Mapo Bridge, an office worker struggles to survive after the cold swordsman Yoo Joonghyuk drops him into a dragon, where a cryptic goblin encounter gives way to rising stomach acid and the discovery of a blue orb.

beats.summary: A black-coated swordsman approaches through the wreckage of the broken bridge
The swordsman confronts an office worker with a cold question
A game-like window identifies the swordsman as Yoo Joonghyuk, a third-round regressor
Yoo seizes the office worker by his collar at the broken edge
Yoo releases the worker above a dragon’s open mouth
Inside the dragon’s stomach, the worker encounters a small goblin and speaks with it
The goblin vanishes, leaving the worker clinging to wall spikes above rising acid
The acid drains away, exposing a blue orb that the worker retrieves

subjects.name: Yoo Joonghyuk
subjects.appearance: tall, broad-shouldered, lean build; charcoal-black trench coat, black shirt, black belt, fitted black trousers, and black dress shoes; black side-parted hair exposing half his forehead; cold, sharply defined face
signature_features: long straight coat silhouette, broad shoulders, and a diagonal back-mounted sword scabbard projecting above one shoulder and below the opposite hip.

subjects.name: Office worker
subjects.appearance: average height, narrow shoulders, long-limbed build; pale-gray fitted suit jacket, white shirt, narrow dark tie, medium-gray trousers, and dark office shoes; short, slightly untidy dark hair
signature_features: conspicuously slim proportions and an elongated fitted jacket silhouette recognizable from every side.

subjects.name: Zombified commuters
subjects.kind: A recurring group of three infected adults
subjects.appearance: one tall and thin in a pale shirt, one short and stocky in a dark padded jacket, and one medium-height in a knee-length gray coat; slack faces and disordered clothing
signature_features: strongly contrasting heights and builds, with crooked, hanging-arm postures readable in silhouette.

subjects.name: Dragon
subjects.appearance: massive dark-gray wedge-shaped head, thick jaw, pale conical teeth, wet mid-gray mouth tissues, and two heavy backward-sweeping horns
signature_features: immense head-to-human scale and a long horned skull silhouette recognizable from any side.

subjects.name: Goblin
subjects.appearance: knee-high body beneath a white spherical head approximately the size of a basketball; two eyes, two short yellow horns rendered pale gray, and a ragged brown garment rendered medium-dark gray
signature_features: an oversized ball-shaped head much wider than its torso, crowned by paired horns.

subjects.name: Summary window
subjects.appearance: translucent sky-blue panel rendered pale gray, with a dark fine border, stepped corners, a title row, and three information rows
signature_features: a fixed rectangular silhouette with stepped corner tabs; presented as a viewer-facing graphic, never an edge-on physical screen.

subjects.name: Blue orb
subjects.appearance: palm-sized, saturated blue rendered medium gray, with a pale pearlescent spiral beneath its glossy surface
signature_features: a perfect round outline and internal spiral visible through the sphere from every direction.
